entities.summary: Paolo Benanti, TOR is an Italian Catholic priest, theologian and academic. He is a member of the Third Order Regular of St. Francis. He teaches at the Pontifical Gregorian University and was advisor to Pope Francis on issues of artificial intelligence and technology ethics.
